views.markdown:
Know the moment someone checks your location.

Chusma New Gen notifies you instantly whenever someone looks up your location through Apple's **Find My** — whether it's a device lookup (Find My Devices) or a person tracking you via location sharing (Find My People). Every lookup is saved to a full tracking log with timestamps.

- **Instant alerts** the moment your location is requested, with the source identified
- **Full tracking log** — every lookup with date and time, grouped by day
- **Statistics** — total lookups, today's count, and last event time in Settings
- **CSV export** of your complete history
- **Daily counter in alerts** ("3 lookups today")
- **Configurable cooldown** — 10s / 30s / 60s / 2m
- **Sound picker** — choose from system alert sounds with preview
- **Notification sender** — disguise alerts as Tips, Maps, Clock, Calendar, Notes, Music, or Mail
- **Custom message** — set your own alert text
- **Show/hide tracking type** toggle
- **Haptic feedback** toggle
- **Modern tracking log** with inset grouped cards and colored icons
- **Swipe to delete** individual entries or clear all
- **Shortcut button** inside the Find My app (iOS 17+)

- Sound picker with preview (Shake, Photo Shutter, Tink, Alarm, etc.)
- Notification sender selection — use any app's icon for the alert banner
- Custom alert message text
- Show Tracking Type toggle
- Modernized tracking log with inset grouped cards and colored icons

- Fixed detection not working on iOS 17 Dopamine — daemons are now restarted on install so hooks load
- Added iOS 17 Secure Locations hooks (FMDSecureLocationMonitor) for reliable detection
- Added rootless package scheme for Dopamine compatibility
- Architecture changed to iphoneos-arm64

- Fixed Find My app crashing on open (removed injection into Find My entirely)
- Chusma no longer loads into any app — only into the Find My daemons and SpringBoard
- Settings remain in the iOS Settings app as before

- Fixed crash in findmydeviced on iOS 17 that caused Find My to freeze and show stale locations
- Location replies now always go out before Chusma runs any detection code

- Added a Send Test Notification button — preview a real alert on demand from Settings
- Added Share Debug Log for easy troubleshooting without SSH
- Reorganized Settings for clarity

- Fixed notifications not appearing on iOS 17 (restored BulletinBoard display path)
- Added iOS 17 Find My People daemon (findmylocated)
- Added on-device debug logging

- Full rewrite for iOS 14–17
- Persistent tracking log with timestamps and daily counts
- Native log viewer with date grouping and swipe-to-delete
- CSV export, statistics, haptics, configurable cooldown
- Rootless jailbreak support (Dopamine / palera1n)
